annotations.title: Coin brief: why it is moving

description: The one-call answer for ONE coin, with the news read (summary, mood, headlines) riding along, in the owner's order: summary (the answer first, the one record sentence at its end), you (the account's saved position on it, when there is one), backdrop (the market this fortnight and the headlines, each by outlet and date, and the market's state with its denominators), on_coin (dated facts, the change feed, situations), move (the move against its usual day and against BTC: usual_day_pct, move_pctile, vs_market), money_now (whales by window with lean at 60% and the hour-adjusted multiple, named accounts as labels, venues, forced closes, the fee, open positions, positioning, options), tracked_accounts (what the Hyperliquid accounts we track hold, both sides in dollars), levels (their real liquidation prices, nearest first; Pro), ahead (dated, each with the last times of that kind as counts a day and a week later), record (what followed the earlier times a day later and in week_later a week later, counts both ways, the coin's ordinary day beside them; present on a quiet coin too), case (points up and points down as sent, neither weighed), what_it_is, sources, gaps and unavailable (a section that could not be read, distinct from one read and empty). Answers "why is X moving" without a second call. view: brief (default), quick (price, funding, open interest only), funding (rate per exchange), crowding (0-100 crowding read, Pro).
